# AI-Powered Ambient Medical Scribe

## Project Overview
An AI-powered ambient scribe that automates medical documentation by listening to doctor-patient conversations and generating structured SOAP notes. Built to reduce physician burnout and administrative burden.

## Technology Stack
- **Backend**: Python with FastAPI
- **Frontend**: React
- **AI/ML**: OpenAI Whisper (speech-to-text), Google Gemini (note generation)
- **Database**: MongoDB with healthcare compliance
- **Real-time**: WebSocket for live transcription
- **Security**: Healthcare-grade encryption and HIPAA compliance

## Key Features
- Ambient listening during consultations
- Real-time speech-to-text transcription
- Speaker identification (doctor vs patient)
- Medical terminology recognition
- Automated SOAP note generation
- Quick review and edit interface
- Secure data handling for healthcare

## Development Guidelines
- Follow HIPAA compliance best practices
- Implement proper data encryption
- Use secure authentication for healthcare professionals
- Structure code for medical workflow integration
- Prioritize real-time performance for clinical use
- Include comprehensive error handling for patient safety
